subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: Al-Raji, a famous physician was, born in Iran. He is remembered for his contribution to inventions of medicines. His famous book is 'Al-Mansuri'. Ibn-Al-Haitham, another great scientist, was born in Iraq. He is mostly known for his contributions to mathematics and medical science.
